analyzed_vuln.description: The vulnerability is a heap-use-after-free caused by a memory management issue in the 'Variant_clear' function, which attempts to access freed memory. Specifically, the 'p->data' field is accessed after it has already been freed, leading to undefined behavior when 'p->arrayLength' is zero. This is triggered by improper handling of memory in 'Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject' that can lead to a premature free of the 'data' field.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The vulnerability can be triggered when the function 'Variant_decodeJson' calls 'Variant_clear' without proper checks on the 'p->data' and 'p->arrayLength' fields, particularly when decoding JSON structures that result in an empty variant.
